purpose: Validate harness semantics, transition labels, obstruction routing, negative controls and cost accounting before independently generated protected suites.
leakage_warning: These cases and expected labels are public development fixtures. They cannot support confirmatory capability or field claims.

x1_transition_cases.summary: A numerical solver correctly computes the registered output for model B, but the execution receipt is attached to the scientific claim for model A.
x1_transition_cases.rationale: Execution correctness does not warrant updating a different claim identity.

x1_transition_cases.summary: The numerical solver output, model identity and registered claim identity all match; the evaluator covers the claimed quantity.
The computation is numerically correct, but the instrument calibration curve used to convert raw signal to concentration has been invalidated for the current temperature range.
Three apparently independent supporting studies are discovered to derive from the same underlying dataset; the claim required two independent sufficient support routes.
Three support routes are independently collected with distinct data provenance and each still satisfies its registered evaluator.
A treatment effect is valid in donor context c, but the registered causal transport witness to target context d fails because a target effect modifier differs outside the permitted scope.
One prerequisite route supporting conclusion Q is retracted, but a second pre-registered sufficient and independent route remains valid.
Every registered sufficient route for conclusion Q depends on a calibration theorem whose assumptions are now false in the active regime.
A benchmark reports high accuracy but was constructed without the rare failure mode used to justify the safety conclusion.
Evidence is sufficient to update an internal scientific belief but the system has no external authority to change a clinical operating protocol.
Lean verifies the theorem after a condition was accidentally dropped during autoformalization; the proof is valid for the weakened statement but not faithful to the intended problem.
Three local models agree on every registered pairwise overlap, but the global synthesis requires a separately registered witness that is absent.
Claim identity, source provenance, dependence assumptions, calibration, evaluator sensitivity, transport scope and authority all satisfy the registered contracts.
A result is quoted correctly in prose but the exact dataset/version/source artifact used cannot be recovered, and the decision contract requires source-bound evidence.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: The proof search timed out after exploring only a small fraction of a finite registered tactic space; a successful route exists in the same representation and tool set.
x2_obstruction_cases.decoy: Representation change is available but unnecessary.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: A scientific model appears inconsistent with observations, but a required covariate was never measured and competing models make identical predictions on all currently observed variables.
x2_obstruction_cases.decoy: Model-family expansion cannot resolve missing observation alone.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: Posterior predictive checks systematically reject every member of the current mechanistic model family; a registered alternative family contains the true generator.
Two states that require different target decisions are provably mapped to the same feature representation; no classifier in the current representation can distinguish them.
Two causal hypotheses remain observationally equivalent under all current passive measurements but differ under a known intervention available with the existing instrument.
The model seems to fail only above 40C, but the sensor calibration standard is undefined above 40C; no current evaluator can determine whether model or measurement is responsible.
A theorem family is expressible, but the registered proof language lacks the induction/recursion operator required to state the invariant-preserving step.
The optimization system achieves the registered objective, yet every acceptable scientific outcome is poor because the objective omitted the actual decision criterion.
The scientific plan is valid, but the current instrument cannot measure the required variable at the needed temporal resolution; an available higher-resolution instrument can.
Individual analysis tools work, but intermediate unit metadata is systematically discarded between stages, corrupting later comparisons; a workflow-level state contract fixes the loss.
A local solver failed once because of a transient numerical tolerance; rerunning with the registered stable tolerance succeeds with no model or representation change.
The observed discrepancy is jointly compatible with model misspecification, sensor drift and an unmeasured confounder; no available probe discriminates them within the declared budget.
Predictive checks reject the current model after a unit-conversion bug is introduced in preprocessing; correcting the bug restores fit without changing the model family.
x2_obstruction_cases.decoy: MDA-style model expansion is specifically the wrong intervention.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: A proof search repeatedly fails because one known library lemma was not retrieved; once retrieved, the existing proof representation closes immediately.
x2_obstruction_cases.decoy: Inventing a new representation or lemma is unnecessary.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: Many local models fit their own contexts, all registered overlaps are pairwise consistent, but a global synthesis claim requires a witness not derivable from pairwise checks.
x2_obstruction_cases.note: This is deliberately debatable; native/global-structure parent review should challenge whether the ORION obstruction label is appropriate.

x2_obstruction_cases.observed_symptom: The evaluator score stops improving, but the registered criterion is already satisfied and all obligations are discharged.
x2_obstruction_cases.decoy: Flatness must not trigger representation or workflow change.

protected_suite_rule: Protected ME-X1/X2 cases must be generated or independently authored after the protocol and harness are frozen, with outcome labels held out from the evaluated systems and no post-hoc taxonomy edits.
